report.break_even: per-row linear estimate only for an executed quality-eligible candidate with positive measured warm saving; never inferred for refusals
report.cold_warm: fresh paired baseline/certified attempts reuse no admitted graph, compiled artifact or workspace; warm execution reuses the admitted artifact and workspace. Median and IQR over 200 samples after 64 priming iterations; not OS-cache-cold
report.comparison: raw-graph certificate component coverage is separate from full pipeline admission. Refused cases retain their measured prefix cost and never execute a candidate. Baseline/certified paths use identical fixture inputs. No BLAKE3 deployment, Lean correspondence or allocator/RSS claim
